posts.title: The behavior of red foxes
posts.body: Red foxes hunt at dusk and cache food under leaves. They live alone for most of the year.

posts.title: A winter walk with Vulpes vulpes
posts.body: Researchers followed Vulpes vulpes across fresh snow and tracked its hunting trails.

posts.title: Why wolves howl
posts.body: Gray wolves howl to keep their pack together and mark territory across the forest.

posts.title: Living with a family retriever
posts.body: These friendly dogs love to fetch and need a long walk every day.

posts.title: Bears before winter
posts.body: Brown bears eat as much as they can in autumn to build fat for hibernation.

posts.title: Deer at dawn
posts.body: White-tailed deer feed in open grass at first light and watch for danger.

posts.title: A stag in the autumn rut
posts.body: A stag with large antlers calls out to rivals during the autumn breeding season.

posts.title: Raising a gray puppy
posts.body: A young puppy with blue eyes needs early training and a lot of patience.

posts.title: Foxes and wolves compared
posts.body: Foxes and wolves are both wild canines but differ in size and in how they hunt.

posts.title: Life of the platypus
posts.body: The platypus is a shy egg-laying mammal that lives in rivers in eastern Australia.

posts.title: Why cats purr
posts.body: A cat purrs when it is relaxed and sometimes when it is stressed or in pain.

posts.title: Night hunters of the forest
posts.body: An owl hunts silently at night using sharp hearing and soft feathers.

posts.title: Grizzly bears fishing for salmon
posts.body: Grizzly bears gather at rivers to catch salmon as the fish swim upstream.

posts.title: A new puppy at home
posts.body: A white puppy settles in on the deck and learns the first rules of the house.

posts.title: The hedgerow hunter
posts.body: A rust-coloured hunter with a white-tipped tail slips through the hedgerows at dusk and pounces on voles.

posts.title: Life in the pack
posts.body: A canine hunter of the far north travels in packs and communicates with long calls at night.

posts.title: Mans best friend
posts.body: Loyal companions that have lived beside people for thousands of years and guard homes and herd sheep.

posts.title: Winter sleepers of the mountains
posts.body: Huge shaggy mammals that eat berries and fish all summer and then sleep through the cold months in a den.

posts.title: Antlers in the mist
posts.body: Graceful grazers with branching antlers move through the misty valley at first light.

posts.title: Silent flyers of the night
posts.body: A bird with large round eyes and a flat face turns its head almost all the way around to find prey in the dark.

posts.title: Why do pets purr
posts.body: Small pets with whiskers purr when they feel safe and they always land on their feet.

posts.title: Animals of the forest
posts.body: Many animals live in the forest and each finds food in its own way.

posts.title: The fox that was mistaken for a wolf
posts.body: Villagers feared a wolf but the animal was a small fox hunting mice.
